name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 24 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-05-12, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
